gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-erode: Blocky and playful, Minecraftia lingers over every character. Erode follows in a serif with a gentle, pencil-soft shift from thick to thin, so a long passage feels dignified and unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-fira-sans: Wide-set, round and commanding, with lowercase that towers over its capitals. Goldman is built for making an entrance with no hairlines at all, while Fira Sans, equally free of thin strokes, does its best work in generous, open sans text.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-general-san: General Sans reads smoothly, its tall x-height filling the line with steady pressure. Love Ya Like A Sister brings the loud, level, outward-pointing swagger that makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-epilogue: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, with c tips that keep a clear distance from closing. Epilogue is the curvier one, and its tall lowercase and stubby ascenders make it the easier choice for running text.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-asap: Asap keeps its body height close to its capitals, and its c forms stay open like gentle arcs. Grandstander, though, is the loud one, cut like sign-shop vinyl.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-supreme: Tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, with terminals cut wide open. Gugi is the showpiece with its constant stroke, while Supreme turns crisp and heavy-looking through the middle of the line for text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-work-sans: Work Sans sets its round letters like bent wire, with a high mean line and c tips that never close in. Metamorphous adds a restrained brush swell above it.
gen-audiowide-fs-familjen-grotesk: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets wide-spaced glyphs with no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet, and its lowercase runs tall against the capitals. Familjen Grotesk is the lively one, with bowls left unfinished on one side for text.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-asap: Oxanium sets big-looking lowercase in uninterrupted monoline strokes, with curves that end in clear daylight. Asap follows with open arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals, and that quiet agreement is the pair's best quality.
gen-megrim-mulish: Angular and measured, Megrim ends every stroke at the same thickness, with a c open like a paperclip. And Mulish handles the text, with horseshoe-open apertures, a large x-height and no thick-and-thin modulation in a plain sans.
